QuestInfo.name: Fluttering Maple Leaves
QuestInfo.0: Rosette, the Battle Square guide, wants you to come to the special event celebrating the #bMaple 8th anniversary#k. But what kind of event is it?
QuestInfo.1: Battle Square provides rewards for celebrating the MapleStory 8th anniversary! You could receive #b#t4001523#s#k based on your accumulated scores from any Battle Mode you participate in. Challenge yourself and win big!
